title: SWF DefineBitsJPEG3 tag and image encoding tests
description: Tests for DefineBitsJPEG3 (tag 35): CharacterId UI16, AlphaDataOffset UI32, JPEG data bytes + alpha (zlib-compressed). Verify when compressionType='photo' BitmapItem uses tag 35 not tag 36. Test CharID is non-zero and output is valid.
